spell_effect.description: Intense heat scorches the target's exterior.
A burst of flame explodes outward in all directions!
A towering inferno erupts, consuming everything in flames!
Gentle waters ease pain and suffering.
A jagged shard of ice pierces the target!
A towering wave of water crashes down, sweeping away everything!
Your skin hardens like stone, resisting damage.
Hands of earth burst from the ground, gripping the target!
A massive boulder flies through the air and crashes into the target!
The earth heaves and a mountain rises, reshaping the battlefield!
Crystals rapidly grow around the target, imprisoning them completely!
You drift down gently, as light as a feather.
A crackling spark leaps to the target!
Molten lava sprays outward, burning everything it touches!
Freezing wind and ice shards assault all in the area!
A violent sandstorm whips through, blinding and abrading!
Your vision shifts, revealing flows of magical energy.
Stone becomes soft and pliable, reshaping to your will.
Flames coalesce into a living form - a Fire Elemental rises to serve you!
Water swirls and takes form - a Water Elemental emerges to aid you!
Stone and soil gather together - an Earth Elemental stands ready!
Wind spirals into a vaguely humanoid form - an Air Elemental appears!
A buzzing swarm of insects materializes, swarming your enemies!
The target's body ripples and transforms into a different creature entirely!
The target shrinks down to a fraction of their size!
A blazing sphere of flame erupts from your hands, roaring through the air!
Soothing waters flow over wounds, knitting flesh and cleansing corruption.
Flames coalesce into a living form - a Fire Elemental rises to serve you!
Wind swirls around the target, lightening their steps and quickening their movements!
The target's limbs grow heavy as if weighed down by the earth itself.
A wall of roaring flames erupts from the ground, forming an impassable barrier!
A gust of wind scatters magical energies, dispelling active enchantments.
